# `silk/platform/windows/clock`

<!-- Generated by silk doc-reference. Do not edit by hand. -->

Windows wall and monotonic clocks without a C runtime.

## When to use
Native clock providers use `WindowsClock` for reads, resolution, and blocking waits.
Application code supplies `OsSystemClock` or `OsMonotonicClock` through the portable services.
